name: Miya
source: Miya is an Antidomi who came from the future just prior to the world falling into the evil organization’s full control. As a member of the Antidomi resistance, she had downloaded a number of future technologies to her brain. Although she may seem to lack emotion, she has a curious mind that is constantly turning.
